checks.label: Divide by the bottom, then multiply by the top: 3/4 of 32 = 24, 1/4 of 20 = 5, 3/4 of 20 = 15, 2/5 of 50 = 20, 2/5 of 30 = 12, 3/8 of 48 = 18, 7/8 of 56 = 49, 5/4 of 16 = 20, 2/3 of 60 = 40; 3/10 of 100 used leaves 70; each puzzle accepts only that answer, and on the tap bar only with three of the four pieces coloured

The swapped slip (divide by the top, multiply by the bottom) gives 125 m from 2/5 of a 50 m drum, more than the drum itself. It gives 75 m from 2/5 of 30 m, 128 from 3/8 of 48, 12.8 from 5/4 of 16 and 90 min from 2/3 of an hour: each is an answer offered, and none is accepted

Sense: 3/4 of 32 and 7/8 of 56 are less than the amount, 5/4 of 16 is more. As drawn, a 64 A answer runs past the 56 A bar, 49 A ends at its seventh eighth and 7 A is under a quarter of it; 2/3 of 30 m (20 m) is more than 3/4 of 24 m (18 m), and so is its shaded length

On the sizes screen a new Check part-way through the motion starts from the picture on screen: the answer bar keeps its length and every label its strength, and the same answer checked again changes nothing
Every demonstration has finished arriving within 4.5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends, and every answer's motion within 2.5 s
